summary: Frontend Task 9 (Pinia funnels store + list page + create/delete dialog) is clean against frontend-relevant OWASP. XSS (A03): user-controlled funnel name/description are rendered only via Vue mustache interpolation ({{ funnel.name }}, {{ funnel.description }}) which auto-escapes; no v-html, innerHTML, eval, or document.write anywhere in the diff. Access control (A01): route projectId and server-supplied funnel.id are used solely to construct API paths and internal Nuxt routes (navigateTo + localePath); the store comment explicitly notes the server enforces ownership with uniform 404 and useApi's onResponseError already handles stale-project 404 cleanup — no client-side trust assumption that leaks data. No open redirect: navigation targets are relative internal paths built from funnel.id (server UUID) and route param, never window.location or user-typed URLs. Secrets (A02/hardcoded): none present; auth/credentials are delegated entirely to the shared useApi() (credentials:'include' + X-XSRF-TOKEN on unsafe methods), consistent with existing stores. Error handling (A09/info disclosure): the store re-throws raw errors but components map them exclusively through useApiError, which resolves only status-code-keyed or generic i18n strings — raw server internals are never surfaced to the user. Destructive-action UX-security: delete is gated behind an explicit confirm Dialog with cancel/confirm and a disabled-while-deleting guard. Input validation: create form uses vee-validate+zod (name required, max 128; description optional, max 1024) mirroring backend constraints. Zero critical/high/medium/low findings.
